content.short: Token launchpad and DEX where anti-rug rules are enforced by the contracts themselves.
content.description: Openlaunch lets anyone launch a token and trade it on real Uniswap v2 and v3 pools, but its contracts rule out the usual scams. Once a token is live nobody can mint more, pause trading or blacklist wallets, and it cannot launch until liquidity is burned or locked with a public unlock date. Names that imitate USDC, USDT or Circle are rejected on-chain. It is live on Stable, with Arc coming.
content.meta: Launch and trade tokens on Openlaunch, where no-mint, locked-liquidity and anti-impersonation rules are enforced on-chain.
